description: Glen worktree guardrails: block edits on the default branch in initialized workspaces and `gh pr merge --delete-branch`; inject workflow context in glen workspaces. Requires `glen` on PATH or in ~/.local/bin; fails open without it.

hooks.command: g=$(command -v glen 2>/dev/null || printf '%s/.local/bin/glen' "$HOME"); [ -x "$g" ] && "$g" hook session-start --agent=claude --context-file "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/pure-bare-worktrees.md" || true
g=$(command -v glen 2>/dev/null || printf '%s/.local/bin/glen' "$HOME"); [ -x "$g" ] && "$g" hook pre-tool-use --agent=claude || true
